event.name: OnAir Demo Day 2027
event.venue: Example Hall, Rua do Exemplo 42, Lisbon.

sessions.title: The Latency Budget
sessions.desc: Where the milliseconds in a user request actually go, and the three changes that bought back half of them.

sessions.title: Docs That Write Back
sessions.desc: Treating documentation as a product: feedback loops, ownership, and why the best docs are the ones that tell you they are wrong.

sessions.title: Small Models, Big Wins
sessions.desc: Shipping compact models to the edge: the trade-offs, the tooling, and a live demo on a laptop older than the speaker’s coffee mug.

sessions.title: Postmortems Without the Blame
sessions.desc: Running incident reviews people actually want to attend, with a template you can steal on the way out.

sessions.title: Lightning: Feature Flags Gone Wild
sessions.desc: A short cautionary tale of 1,200 feature flags and how a team cleaned them up in a week.

sessions.title: Testing in Production, Responsibly
sessions.desc: Canaries, shadow traffic and kill switches: how to learn from real traffic without learning the hard way.

sessions.title: The Boring Architecture Manifesto
sessions.desc: A deliberately unexciting talk about choosing well-understood technology and spending the saved energy on the product.
